The broad Game Hub gate reported nine failures, all in concurrently owned 016-hexbound-rooftops. MIRRORSHIFT, 014, and 017 passed; no foreign files were modified.
Concurrent recent activity remained in lanes 014, 016, and 017. The owned 015 package was isolated; its manifest and package inputs remained stable during final verification.

Prioritize client frame-time work and target-hardware profiling, then physical four-phone LAN, human mix/listening, human balance/character attachment, and deeper animation/voice/content breadth.
